gates.name: evidence_and_rights
gates.detail: Every bet resolves to licensed official evidence, dated operator rules, an executable accepted quote and a hashed forecast

gates.name: chronology
gates.detail: Features <= forecast <= acceptance < kickoff; no duplicate parlay legs; disjoint seasonal windows

gates.name: sample
gates.detail: Minimum untouched holdout bets, season-week clusters and seasons

gates.name: probability_quality
gates.detail: Matched forecast artifacts; action-conditional paired Brier improvement lower bound > 0 and no worse log loss

gates.name: economics
gates.detail: Stake-weighted holdout net ROI lower confidence bound > 0 and mean ROI >= protocol floor

gates.name: multiplicity
gates.detail: Bonferroni across every registered trial; BH q secondary

gates.name: stability
gates.detail: Positive in >=2/3 holdout seasons, no season >50% of profit, and positive after decimal slippage

gates.name: execution_and_risk
gates.detail: Accepted executable quotes are evidence-verified; drawdown and weekly exposure are within pre-registered unit limits

gates.name: forward_freeze
